scenes.title: Deepu Residence
lines: This is Deepu Residence at Hosangadi.
A contemporary tropical home, designed by Woodland Architects.

scenes.title: Light, without heat
lines: The feature gable uses vertical timber louvers.
They light up the double-height living room, but keep out the harsh afternoon sun.

scenes.title: Shade for the monsoon
lines: A floating concrete canopy with a wooden ceiling shades the entrance and a two-car porch, right through the monsoon.

scenes.title: An open, green core
lines: Inside, the sitout leads into the living room, then a central dining and family space beside a green courtyard.
Four bedrooms, a prayer room and a separate wet kitchen complete the plan.

scenes.title: Stone, wood, concrete
lines: Natural materials that age beautifully in our climate.

scenes.title: Your home, next?
lines: Planning your home? Let's design it together.

end_lines: Follow for more smart home design.
caption:
Project reveal: Deepu Residence, Hosangadi 🌴 A contemporary tropical home with a timber-louvered feature gable, a floating canopy over a two-car porch, and an open plan wrapped around a green courtyard.
